data.summary: When this unit is chosen to fight in the same turn as its **Charge move**, its models' melee weapons have **[[ANTI-MONSTER 4+]](vsdata:weapon-ability/anti)** and **[[ANTI-VEHICLE 4+]](vsdata:weapon-ability/anti)** for the rest of that phase.
